detail.title: Obstacles to Ethical Decision-Making and Obedience Limits
detail.summary: Explores how mental models and obedience pressures create vulnerabilities in intelligent systems and hinder independent ethical reasoning.
detail.reason: Synthesizes the collected evidence on obedience limits and obstacles to ethical decision-making for the active project.

children.title: Limits of Obedience in Intelligent Systems

detail.title: Limits of Obedience in Intelligent Systems
detail.question: Under what circumstances does obedience become a failure of intelligence?
detail.reason: Addresses the active topic of obedience limits and examines conditions where following orders degrades epistemic or ethical outcomes.
